decisions.reason: Defining visual object Type 1 as a grid of objects does not change the required number of questions per level or the question-review sequence.
The visual form assigned to object Type 1 does not alter how related levels progress or how skills are split across curriculum blocks.
The object representation decision does not change the rule for copying a question into each applicable level.
Specifying a grid of objects as one visual object type neither resolves nor changes grade-level curriculum coverage.
The source defines a visual content representation and does not change the deferred C# generator requirement, its constraints, or its runtime environment.
